Name: pathway_stratified_mantel
Title: Is the ESM-2 / Essentiality Correlation Driven by Protein Family or Pathway Co-membership?
Experiment: Using cached embeddings and essentiality distances from run_0, stratify gene pairs into three groups: (1) same KEGG pathway (fetch pathway membership via KEGG API for all 2000 genes), (2) same protein family (use Pfam domain overlap — genes sharing at least one Pfam domain), (3) neither. Compute mean ESM-2 cosine distance and mean essentiality correlation for each group. Run a partial Mantel test controlling for pathway co-membership: does the ESM-2 / essentiality correlation persist after removing the contribution of pathway co-membership? If yes, ESM-2 is capturing something beyond pathway labels. If no, the correlation is explained by pathway structure alone. Report mean distances per group and partial Mantel r with p-value.
